metrics.profile_summary: Early-career marketing professional with a strong background in account management and digital strategy. Experienced in managing high-profile global brands and executing creative campaigns. Skilled in client servicing, project management, and social media growth.

education.institution: Shaheed Zulfiqar Ali Bhutto Institute of Science and Technology (SZABIST)

experience.description: Manages key accounts for Unilever, Continental Biscuits, and PMI. Leads creative strategies for Spotify and Lipton, overseeing the full project lifecycle from research and budgeting to execution.
Conducted market research to support brand development in the oil and fuel industry and executed a digital campaign focused on corporate internships.
Developed Meta platform presence through audience research and creative design, utilizing analytics to optimize content and increase brand engagement.
Designed curriculum and classroom management strategies for 400 students, implementing innovative teaching methods to improve learning effectiveness.
Led a women's empowerment society, directing a team of 30-40 women to implement initiatives promoting gender equality and inclusivity.
Organized campus events to enhance student engagement and developed leadership skills through event planning and execution.
